critical_code_review_comments: CORS resolution is correct: `allow_origins:['*']` + `allow_credentials:False` sidesteps the ingress-Origin-rewrite problem entirely because ACAO is a literal '*' and the browser doesn't compare against its own Origin (no credentialed request). The web frontend is same-origin so its cookie auth still works; the mobile Expo preview and the Partner API both use bearer tokens which don't need credentials mode. Reference: /app/backend/server.py CORS middleware.

rca of the issue: iter128 CORS RCA: the K8s/Cloudflare ingress rewrote the client Origin to an internal cluster hostname before hitting FastAPI, causing the regex-echo ACAO to mismatch the browser's real origin. iter129 FIX applied by main agent: since every cross-origin browser caller of this API (Expo web preview + external Partner API) uses BEARER TOKEN auth (not cookies) and the web app is same-origin with the API, the CORS middleware now returns a LITERAL 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' with allow_credentials=False. Browsers no longer perform an Origin-comparison against ACAO when it's the wildcard and no credentials are involved, so the ingress rewrite is a non-issue. Verified: (a) curl OPTIONS + GET both return ACAO:* with no ACAC header, (b) in-browser Playwright on the Expo preview shows zero CORS console errors and successful demo login + data fetches. Web (cookie) auth is unaffected because it is same-origin (no cross-origin CORS check performed). Meal-credits RCA: iter127+iter128 test runs consumed all seeded credits on test@ and demo@; main agent topped both up to 5 available before iter129.
